title: DISPOSITION v1 item
description: internal/disposition.Item -- one queued approval item. Shared by list_pending and dispose's own response wire objects, which both embed it verbatim (referenced by $ref, never redeclared).

payload.description: Opaque per-kind JSON payload -- shape depends on kind, not constrained here.

defer_count.description: How many times this item has been deferred.

edited_payload.description: Opaque JSON payload attached by an edit_accept verdict -- not constrained here.

route.description: Set only for a distill item disposed through the capture routing path.

resurfaced.description: True once a parked item has been resurfaced back to pending -- a one-time transition.

route_effect_pending.description: Optional recovery marker for a committed precept-draft route whose follow-on staging has not completed. Absent on legacy and completed routes.

applied_entry_id.description: Committed ledger entry ID for an accepted precept draft or child intent.

ledger_effect_pending.description: Optional recovery intent committed with new ledger acceptances; cleared after publication. Absent on legacy unmarked effects.

applied_publication_id.description: Optional completion receipt ID for an accepted dirty edit or compaction pass.

applied_claim_id.description: The claim id a reconcile item's accept/edit_accept verdict wrote to the canonical brain repo, once applied.
